nodes.label: Montane (Alpine) Forest
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Forests varying with altitude in mountainous regions. Wet temperate forests (1000-2000m): oaks, chestnuts. Temperate forests with coniferous species (1500-3000m): pine, deodar, spruce, fir. Alpine meadows above treeline (3000-4000m): grasslands and scrubs. Above 5000m: permanent snow, no vegetation. Similar zonation in Western Ghats at lower elevations.

nodes.label: Deodar (Himalayan Cedar)
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Coniferous tree found in the western Himalayas at 1500-3200m altitude. One of the most valued timber trees of India. Durable, rot-resistant wood used for construction, railway sleepers, and furniture. Name means 'timber of gods'. State tree of Himachal Pradesh. Found in J&K, HP, and Uttarakhand.
